note: Ground-truth answer key for Flowprint v0.1-alpha benchmark. Ghost's HTTP API is Express (custom-wrapped via core/shared/express.js), NOT Next.js App Router. The v0.1-alpha analyzer's route scope is Next.js App Router only, so routes[] is intentionally EMPTY and the Ghost route surface is encoded as explicit out-of-scope boundary entries. Only facts re-verified against the cloned tree at the pinned SHA are included; the tree at SHA is ground truth.
appsNote: No GENUINE Next.js apps at SHA: the ghost server package (ghost/core) is Express, and no package has `next` in deps with an App Router tree. KNOWN HEURISTIC COLLISION: apps/ember-admin (package name 'ghost-admin', ember-source dep, no next dep — R) is the Ember admin UI; its app/adapters/page.js, app/models/page.js, app/serializers/page.js and app/utils/route.js files collide with the Next.js App Router page/route file heuristic. A v0.1-alpha analyzer may report it as an app at I with 4 route files — these are NOT Next.js routes. The fixture records 0 genuine Next.js apps.

Full path composition: vhost(config.getBackendMountPath()) + /ghost/api (BASE_API_PATH in core/shared/url-utils.ts:4 — R) + /content|/admin (literal in api/app.js — R) + leaf path. NOT Next.js App Router — out of v0.1-alpha route scope. Surfaced as unknown/not-claimed.

app.lazyUse(mountPath, requireFn) is a Ghost-specific lazy mount defined in core/shared/express.js:30 (verified at SHA) — a future Ghost detector must treat it as app.use(path, module). Not a v0.1-alpha concern.

http(api.<group>.<action>) from @tryghost/api-framework is a pass-through wrapper (verified in published tarball); resolution must treat http(X) as transparent and resolve X through the barrel core/server/api/index.js (module.exports.endpoints = require('./endpoints') — R, verified at SHA) → endpoints/index.js → per-resource files. CJS require-chain importCases below encode the first hops.
Outermost vhost mount prefix comes from config.getBackendMountPath() (boot.js:256) — effective full public URLs need runtime config → U without env.

apps/ember-admin is an Ember app (ghost-admin; ember-source in deps; no next dep — R, verified at SHA). Ember's app/*/page.js and app/utils/route.js conventions collide with the Next.js App Router file heuristic (app/ dir containing page/route files). The analyzer's I-level app claim ('router conventions present but `next` not found in package.json deps') is the honest handling — the 4 emitted route files (/adapters, /models, /serializers, /utils) are NOT Next.js routes and must not be treated as R app detection.
